manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the black and white plastic microphone from the table and pass it over.

Task description: Pick up the black-and-white plastic microphone on the right side of the table and hand it from the right hand to the left hand.

Success criteria: The left gripper is closed, contacting and holding the microphone, while the right gripper is open and has released it. The microphone is left of the robot body centerline at an airborne handover position approximately twenty centimeters or more above the table.

## Execution tips

- The right hand can grip a straight section of the black handle near, but not at, its tapered end. Avoid the end and leave the section near the microphone head free for the left hand.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the handle and close across it. Before closing, confirm the pads are on the sides rather than pressing only on top.
- During handoff, have the two grippers occupy separate, nonoverlapping sections of the handle and leave clearance between the fingers. Wait until the left hand has a secure grip before releasing with the right to avoid collision or dropping it.
